sources.title: RFC 3227: Evidence Collection and Archiving
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Plaso log2timeline：解析器覆蓋、錯誤帳本與可重跑擷取
related.titleEn: Plaso log2timeline: parser coverage, error ledgers and reproducible extraction
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付acquisition-schedule.csv、timeliness.json、複本清單與限制說明；不得把虛構緩衝區當成任何作業系統的真實保存時間。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver acquisition-schedule.csv, timeliness.json, a copy manifest and limitations. Do not present these fictional buffer deadlines as retention characteristics of any actual operating system or collection tool.
related.difference: 為每個虛構來源檔保留識別碼、雜湊、解析器選擇、成功狀態及錯誤；建立可由同一來源重跑的命令規格，不需安裝Plaso才能完成算例。
related.differenceEn: Preserve identifier, hash, parser selection, outcome and error for every fictional source file. Write a reproducible extraction specification; the arithmetic fixture must remain runnable without installing Plaso.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: RFC 3227強調揮發性與記錄保存流程；本例採單一工作者、已知時間、互不相依的簡化模型，非通用現場鑑識排程最佳化證明。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 工作A用時2分鐘截止3，B用時4截止8，C用時1截止10；從0開始；每個完成時間等於開始加用時。 A-B-C完成於2、6、7，三份及時；B-A-C完成於4、6、7，A超過截止3分鐘，只有兩份及時。

log2timeline擷取事件、pinfo與psort處理儲存與輸出；一個來源可產生多事件，所以檔案覆蓋與事件數是不同指標。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 來源100個，80成功、12未支援、8失敗；成功來源產生4000事件。指定工具版本、解析器清單及每次執行的獨立輸出名稱。 已成功擷取的來源覆蓋為80/100=80%；平均每個成功來源50事件不能用來推論其餘20個來源的內容。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: RFC 3227 emphasizes volatility and documented collection. This exercise assumes one worker, known durations and independent tasks; its schedule comparison is not a universal optimization claim for live forensic acquisition. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Task A lasts two minutes and expires at minute 3; B lasts four and expires at 8; C lasts one and expires at 10. Start at zero and compute completion from start plus duration. The A-B-C order completes at 2, 6 and 7, preserving all three on time. B-A-C completes at 4, 6 and 7; A misses its deadline by three minutes, leaving two timely acquisitions.

log2timeline extracts events while pinfo and psort support storage inspection and output. One source can produce many events, so file coverage and extracted event count must be reported separately. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. There are 100 source files: 80 successful, 12 unsupported and eight failed, producing 4,000 events from successful inputs. Pin tool version, parser list and a separate output name for every run. Successful source coverage is 80/100=80%. The average of 50 events per successful source gives no evidence about the content of the other twenty sources.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kubernetes ResourceQuota：請求額度、執行用量與可排程性的差別
related.titleEn: Kubernetes ResourceQuota: admission budgets versus usage and schedulability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付acquisition-schedule.csv、timeliness.json、複本清單與限制說明；不得把虛構緩衝區當成任何作業系統的真實保存時間。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver acquisition-schedule.csv, timeliness.json, a copy manifest and limitations. Do not present these fictional buffer deadlines as retention characteristics of any actual operating system or collection tool.
related.difference: 從合成Pod清單累計CPU requests，計算新Pod是否超額；另記limits及觀測用量，禁止以低使用率繞過額度判斷。
related.differenceEn: Sum CPU requests from a synthetic Pod inventory and decide whether a new Pod exceeds quota. Record limits and observed utilization separately; low current usage must not bypass the admission-budget calculation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: RFC 3227強調揮發性與記錄保存流程；本例採單一工作者、已知時間、互不相依的簡化模型，非通用現場鑑識排程最佳化證明。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 工作A用時2分鐘截止3，B用時4截止8，C用時1截止10；從0開始；每個完成時間等於開始加用時。 A-B-C完成於2、6、7，三份及時；B-A-C完成於4、6、7，A超過截止3分鐘，只有兩份及時。

ResourceQuota限制命名空間累計宣告資源與物件；配額允許不等於Pod一定能排程，且配額不是資料存取授權或機密隔離。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 配額requests.cpu為8核心，現有10個Pod各要求0.6核心，合計6；新Pod要求2.5，觀測CPU只有2核心但不參與額度相加。 新總請求8.5核心，超額0.5，所以本例拒絕；若新要求改2核心，總數8剛好符合該配額。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: RFC 3227 emphasizes volatility and documented collection. This exercise assumes one worker, known durations and independent tasks; its schedule comparison is not a universal optimization claim for live forensic acquisition. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Task A lasts two minutes and expires at minute 3; B lasts four and expires at 8; C lasts one and expires at 10. Start at zero and compute completion from start plus duration. The A-B-C order completes at 2, 6 and 7, preserving all three on time. B-A-C completes at 4, 6 and 7; A misses its deadline by three minutes, leaving two timely acquisitions.

ResourceQuota constrains aggregate declared resources and objects in a namespace. Passing quota admission does not guarantee schedulability, and quota is neither data-access authorization nor a confidentiality boundary. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The requests.cpu quota is eight cores. Ten existing Pods each request 0.6, totaling six; a new Pod requests 2.5. Observed use is only two cores but is excluded from quota arithmetic. The proposed total is 8.5 cores, exceeding quota by 0.5, so this fixture rejects admission. Reducing the new request to two cores produces a total of eight, satisfying that quota.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
